title: Phase 6 queue snapshot contract boundary cleanup
summary: Migrates queue snapshot contract imports from the desktop compatibility export to the existing core contract owner and removes the matching temporary boundary allowlist row.
reason: Phase 6 boundary cleanup is reducing queue core-to-desktop imports in bounded contract-only slices while leaving priority marker behavior for separate queue work.

rollback_plan: Restore the queue snapshot contract import to mediapipeline.desktop.contracts, restore the removed allowlist row, refresh the generated queue snapshot summary, and mark AB-QUE-017 open again in the edge ledger.
notes:
